title: Verify the total-C6 zero at intermediate angles and the physical packing-gain ceiling (Rb 60P3/2 stretched pair)

c6_pp_theta0_60_diagonalization_ghz_um6.anchored_to: E1 full pair-Hamiltonian diagonalization at theta=0 (wide energy window), reproduced here by the second-order sum (-10.411) and hand-built full diag (window-30: -9.63)

c6_pp_theta90_60_ghz_um6.anchored_to: E1 full diagonalization at theta=90 (near-Forster S+S channel; perturbative value 299.11, diagonalization 268.08). E4 hand-built full diag gives +291.1 (isolated-state, with Zeeman-split m-manifold).

c6_ss_60_ghz_um6.anchored_to: Singer n^11 + QDT formula for the Rb 60S1/2 pair, cross-checked against ARC perturbative C6 in E1. Used as the strong-blockade threshold |C6_SS|.

ss_baseline_density_per_um2.anchored_to: E2 densest SS staggered packing density (atoms/um^2) used as the gain denominator.

target_pair.value: Rb 60P3/2 m=3/2 stretched pair (n=60, l=1, j=1.5, m=1.5)

quantities.observable: Interatomic angle (deg) at which the isolated-stretched-state van der Waals C6 of the Rb 60P3/2 pair crosses zero (repulsive at smaller angle, attractive at larger angle), quantized axis along z, interatomic axis at angle theta.
quantities.uncertainty_source: canonical value is the three-channel root 24.65 deg (all-channel second-order sum); the full diagonalization gives 24.0 deg (window-30 D+D truncation). The previous headline 24.3+-0.35 deg (inter-method average) is superseded by 24.65 deg.

limit_check.observed: C6(24deg)=+0.007 / -0.93, C6(25deg)=+1.48 / +0.52 (diag / second-order); sign flips across ~24 deg

superseded.superseded_by_meaning: three-channel root (all-channel second-order sum, n_range 55-65); adopted as the canonical zero angle in E6's packing analysis

quantities.observable: Minimum |C6| (GHz um^6) over the sampled angles in [20,26] deg; tests the decision rule threshold |C6| < 1 GHz um^6.
quantities.uncertainty_source: full-diag min |C6| = 0.0068 at its 24.0 deg zero; second-order min |C6| = 0.0059 at its 24.65 deg zero — both < 1 GHz um^6 (the zero is real); ~15% inter-method spread

limit_check.limit: |C6| < 1 GHz um^6 at some angle in [20,26]
limit_check.observed: 0.0068 (diag, 24.0 deg zero) and 0.0059 (second-order, 24.65 deg zero), both < 1 GHz um^6

quantities.observable: C6 (GHz um^6) at theta = 54.7 deg (the dM=0-channel magic angle where (1-3cos^2 theta)=0), for the Rb 60P3/2 stretched pair.
quantities.uncertainty_source: second-order 126.10 vs full diag 126.43; vs E3 two-channel model 120.30 (the ~6 GHz um^6 difference is the neglected dM=+-1 channel)

limit_check.limit: positive (attractive), close to E3's model value 120.3

quantities.observable: Coefficient b of the dM=+-1 dipole channel (sin^2(theta)cos^2(theta)) in the three-channel decomposition C6(theta)=a(1-3cos^2 theta)^2 + b sin^2 cos^2 + c sin^4, for the Rb 60P3/2 stretched pair (n_range 55-65).
quantities.uncertainty_source: least-squares fit over 19 angles (residual ~0); a=-2.60, b=-22.72, c=+295.62

limit_check.limit: b nonzero (the two-channel model assumed b=0)
limit_check.observed: -22.7 GHz um^6 (8% of c=295.6), shifting the zero from 22.9 deg to ~24.3-24.7 deg

quantities.observable: First-order quadrupole-quadrupole coefficient C5 (GHz um^5) at the C6 zero angle (24.65 deg); V_QQ = -C5/R^5.
quantities.uncertainty_source: exact single diagonal matrix element <aa|V_QQ|aa> (no sum); sign convention V=-C5/R^5; C5(theta) = -6<Q0>^2 P4(cos theta) with <Q0>~-5.4e6 a.u.

limit_check.limit: nonzero (stretched P state has a quadrupole moment)

quantities.observable: Second-order dipole-quadrupole coefficient C8 (GHz um^8) at the C6 zero angle (24.65 deg); V_DQ = -C8/R^8.
quantities.uncertainty_source: sum over 4200 dipole-quadrupole channels (n_range 58-62, l_range 0-3); convergence not swept

quantities.observable: Maximum 2D packing-density gain of PP gate pairs over SS, over gate-axis angle and quantization tilt, subject to the strong-blockade constraint |C6(theta_gate)| >= |C6_SS| = 138.86 GHz um^6.
quantities.uncertainty_source: orientation-grid spread (baseline theta=90/psi=0 gives 1.331; best found theta=90/psi=15 gives 1.350); optimizer heuristic, not a certified global max

limit_check.limit: <= 1.6 (strong blockade removes the divergent near-zero orientations)

method_blocked.intended_tool: pairinteraction 2.5.1 SystemPair.set_distance(angle_degree=...) for full diagonalization at intermediate angles
method_blocked.failing_command: python3 -c "import pairinteraction as pi; ps=pi.SystemPair(pb).set_distance(6.0, angle_degree=25, unit='micrometer').set_interaction_order(3).diagonalize(); print(ps.get_eigenenergies(unit='GHz'))" (compared theta=0/25/90)
method_blocked.verbatim_last_error: theta=25 vs 0: max|dE| = 0.0 nonzero count = 0 (eigenvalue spectrum identical for theta=0/25/90)
method_blocked.fallback_used: hand-built full pair-Hamiltonian (dipole-dipole) diagonalization in scipy with explicit angle-dependent C3(theta) and a Zeeman term (zeeman_ghz=0.005) to lift the m-degeneracy (E4 pair_dipole_diag)
method_blocked.why_blocked: pairinteraction 2.5.1's SystemPair applies the distance but ignores the angle in the interaction matrix (the eigenvalue spectrum is unchanged for theta=0/25/90; only get_overlaps rotates the target). A second independent issue: without a quantization field the 16-fold |60P3/2 m_a>x|60P3/2 m_b> degeneracy makes the naive max-overlap tracking return the theta=0 energy for theta<=35 deg.

premise_corrections.premise: E3 two-channel C6 model: total-C6 zero at 22.909 deg (c0 anchored at theta=0 and c2 at theta=90, dM=+-1 channel assumed negligible)
premise_corrections.corrected: The dM=+-1 channel is NOT negligible (b = -22.7 GHz um^6, 8% of c2). The all-channel sum and the full diagonalization place the zero at ~24.0-24.7 deg (headline 24.3 deg), ~1.4 deg from the two-channel value.
premise_corrections.consequence: The zero is real but slightly displaced; C6(54.7deg)=126.3 (not 120.3). Downstream: any packing geometry tuned to the exact 22.9 deg zero must instead use ~24.3 deg; the strong-blockade-constrained gain (~1.35) is unaffected since it forces theta_gate >= ~58 deg.

premise_corrections.premise: E1 channel decomposition reported sin4_fraction = 0.9999999 (dM=+-1 channel negligible)
premise_corrections.corrected: That fraction was fit to pairinteraction's pi.C6 angle scan, which silently drops BOTH the dM=0 and dM=+-1 channels for the stretched pair. The explicit all-channel second-order sum gives a=-2.60, b=-22.72, c=+295.62 (sin4 fraction ~0.93 among the three channels).
premise_corrections.consequence: The two-channel model used in E2/E3 is a 2-channel approximation, not exact; intermediate-angle C6 needs all three channels.

computed.acceptance_criterion: Confirmatory. Predict: the physical C6(theta) of the Rb 60P3/2 stretched pair passes through zero at theta* in [20,26] deg (repulsive at smaller theta, attractive at larger theta), with min|C6(theta)| < 1 GHz um^6 in [20,26]; the next-order interaction near theta* is finite (C5/C8); and the strong-blockade-constrained max 2D packing gain <= 1.6x. Verdict reads computed.c6_diag_min_abs_ghz_um6_in_20_26 and computed.c6_total_zero_angle_deg and computed.strong_blockade_max_gain_2d. CONFIRMED iff min|C6| < 1 GHz um^6 AND C6 changes sign across theta* in [20,26]. REFUTED (zero is an artifact) iff |C6| >= 10 GHz um^6 at all sampled angles in [20,26].

method_blocked_resolved.intended_tool: pairinteraction 2.5.1 SystemPair.set_distance(angle_degree=...) for full diagonalization at intermediate angles
method_blocked_resolved.fallback_used: hand-built full dipole-dipole diagonalization (scipy) with explicit angle-dependent C3(theta) and Zeeman term (0.005 GHz) to lift the m-degeneracy
method_blocked_resolved.cross_check: hand-built diagonalization cross-checked against the all-channel second-order sum: 0.04% central-value agreement at theta=0 (E1 wide-window diag -10.408 vs second-order -10.412) and ~1% at intermediate angles (C6(45deg)=67.63 diag vs 67.57 second-order, 0.08%; C6(54.7deg)=126.43 vs 126.10, 0.26%; C6(90deg)=291.08 vs 293.02, 0.66%)
method_blocked_resolved.disposition: accepted - the fallback reproduces the field-standard full-diagonalization result, so no evidence-grade downgrade is required
